faqs.question: I am unable to connect my product to a wireless network. What should I do?
faqs.answer: The printer does not come with built-in wireless features and does not support a wireless (or Ethernet) connection to a network router. Only a direct wired connection to the computer is supported.

faqs.question: Can I use hole-punched paper with my product?
faqs.answer: No. The product does not support this paper type.

faqs.question: When I try to print to my product in Windows 7, printing is slow or my product stops printing. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Select a lower quality setting in the printer software.
Make sure your system meets the minimum system requirements for your printer.
Close the
Devices and Printers
window before you print.
Clear space on your hard drive or run a defragmentation utility.
Close programs that you're not using.
Increase your system's memory.

faqs.question: I brought my product with me to a different country and can't find ink for it. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Some Epson printers and ink cartridges are specific to a regional market and not sold worldwide, although the same printers are sold in the U.S. and Canada. If you have a printer sold in the U.S. or Canada, you may not be able to easily get ink cartridges for it in foreign markets.
Unfortunately, because of customs and tax regulations, the Epson E-Stores in the U.S. and Canada are unable to ship to addresses outside the U.S. and Canada.

faqs.question: Can the printer still print if an ink cartridge is expended or not installed?
faqs.answer: No. The printer will not operate if any cartridge is expended or removed. It's best to always have extra cartridges on hand.

faqs.question: Does Epson have a program where I can donate my working electronic equipment?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Epson America, Inc. and
Digitunity
have joined together with the goal of helping those who are facing economic challenges or have a disability to gain access to today's technology. With your donation, you not only help the environment, but you also help change the lives of those who need these products the most.

faqs.question: Heavy coated or thick paper does not load correctly or loads skewed. What should I do?
faqs.answer: The paper you are using may be too heavy or glossy for the paper roller to pick up. Be sure the paper is within printer specifications.

faqs.question: Does OS X support manual duplex printing with my product?
faqs.answer: This feature is not supported in Mac OS X. However, if your printer has a built-in automatic duplexer, auto-duplexing is supported in Mac OS X 10.6 (Snow Leopard).

faqs.question: How do I change the font size of text when I print from software in Windows?
faqs.answer: You need to select the text or font size in the software you are printing from, not the printer driver. For detailed instructions, contact the company for the application you are printing from.

faqs.question: Can I print on transparencies?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Epson cannot guarantee the print quality on transparencies, but for best results select
Plain Paper
as the

faqs.question: I see the message Cannot connect to Internet in Windows 8.1 after I select Driver Update in my product software. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
The
Driver Update
option does not work in Windows 8.1. All other driver options will work correctly.

faqs.question: A color ink cartridge is expended even though I print in black only. Why does this happen?
faqs.answer:
To keep the print head clear and ready to print, the printer uses a small amount of ink from all the cartridges whenever it prints.   Even if you select
Black ink Only
, some color ink is still being used.

faqs.question: How do I know when an ink cartridge needs to be replaced?
faqs.answer:
When the ink replace light is on, the printer will require you to change the cartridge. You need to replace a cartridge when it's expended or it gets too old. See
Checking the Ink Supply
and
Replacing an Ink Cartridge
.

faqs.question: How do I replace an ink cartridge?
faqs.answer:
See
Replacing an Ink Cartridge
.

faqs.question: How long should an ink cartridge remain in my product if it's not used often?
faqs.answer: When an installed ink cartridge is more than six months old, you may need to replace it if you notice that your printouts don't look as good as they used to and quality doesn't improve after cleaning and aligning the print head.

faqs.question: I installed new ink cartridges and my product seems to be doing a long cleaning cycle. Is this normal?
faqs.answer:
When an ink cartridge is installed in the printer, it will take about half a minute to charge the ink system and initialize the printer. While the ink is charging the
power light flashes. Never turn off the printer while the
power light is flashing (unless the printer hasn't moved or made noise for more than 5 minutes). This initialization is a normal and necessary process. If the printer initialization does not stop after 5 minutes turn the printer off and contact Epson technical support for assistance.

faqs.question: Can the Epson ink cartridges be refilled or can I use third-party ink cartridges without voiding the warranty?
faqs.answer:
Epson does not recommend refilling or using other brands of ink cartridges.  Epson uses a permanent Micro Piezo print head that has allowed Epson to lead the industry in delivering consistent photo image quality by using variable-sized droplets.  Micro Piezo print head can also use a wider variety of inks, which has allowed Epson to introduce such ink breakthroughs as DURABrite® and Epson UltraChrome® inks that offer greatly improved humidity resistance, smudge resistance, and fade resistance.
Using refilled ink cartridges will not void the product's original warranty; however, if these products cause a failure, the repair of that failure will not be covered under warranty.

faqs.question: How can I stop my product from feeding multiple pages at the same time?
faqs.answer:
If multiple pages feed, follow these steps:
Remove the paper from the sheet feeder.
Fan the edges of the sheets.
Reload them against the right side of the feeder.
Slide the left edge guide snugly, but not too tightly, against the paper. Don't load paper above the arrow mark on the left edge guide and make sure it is under the tabs on the left and right edge guides.
If that doesn't help, make sure the paper you're using is not too thin or too thick. If it is very humid, the paper may have absorbed moisture and should be replaced with dry paper. If necessary, try different paper from a new package. Check the
paper specifications
for information about supported paper sizes and thicknesses.

faqs.question: Can I use sheet labels with my product?
faqs.answer:
Yes, Epson makes
Photo Quality Self Adhesive Sheets
. To avoid paper jams, load only one sheet at a time. Also, set the
Type
or
Media Type
setting in the driver to
Matte Paper - Heavyweight
.

faqs.question: My product won't feed paper. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
See
Paper does not feed

faqs.question: Does the type of paper I use really make a difference?
faqs.answer: Yes. The type of paper you choose affects the way your printout looks, so be sure to select the correct media for your job. If you are just printing a rough draft of an image, plain paper is fine. For the best results, however, you'll want to use one of Epson's special ink jet papers designed for your printer.

faqs.question: How should I load envelopes?
faqs.answer:
See
Printing on Envelopes

faqs.question: Sometimes the paper doesn't eject all the way or is wrinkled. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Make sure the correct paper size is selected in your application and/or printer software. If the paper doesn't eject fully, it may be too long for the printer. If the paper is wrinkled, it may be damp or too thin. Check the
paper specifications
in the User's Guide for information about supported paper sizes and thicknesses.

faqs.question: The quality of my printed output is unacceptable. What should I do?

faqs.question: My printout has lines running through it. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
If your printouts contain vertical banding or misaligned lines, you may need to
align the print head

faqs.question: The image look inverted, as if viewed in a mirror. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
You may have accidentally selected the
Mirror Image
or
Flip Horizontal
option in the printer driver or a similar feature in your software application. Turn off the setting in the printer driver and/or application and try printing again.

faqs.question: My printouts are missing color and/or black print. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
See
Incorrect or missing colors

faqs.question: My printout has incorrect margins. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
If the margins are incorrect, the problem could be due to a software setting or the paper may be loaded incorrectly. See
Incorrect margins
.
Otherwise, check to see if there is a
Printer Friendly Version
(or similarly named) icon or link on the web page that you can click on. If not, experiment with page setup and paper size, then select
Print Preview
from the
File
menu in your web browser to view the changes.

faqs.question: Web pages don't print the way they appear on my monitor. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
The pages may not print correctly due to the web page design. Try the following:
Check for a
Printer-friendly Version
(or similarly named) option on the web page.
Change the page setup and paper size settings, and select the preview option in your browser to check the changes before you print.

Select all the files and folders with
Epson

Open your hard drive, select
Library
>
Printers
, the
Epson
folder and drag it to the trash.
On your hard drive, select
Users
>
Library
>
Preferences
>
Epson
, select the files named
com.apple.print.
[XXXXXXX]
.plist
(XXXXXX represents any name)	and then drag the files to the trash.
From the Apple menu, select
System Preferences
and click
Print & Fax
.
Press the
Control
and
Apple
button on your keyboard at the same time, then click anywhere in the printer list. Select
Reset printing system...
.
Click
OK

Add

Restart
your Mac.

Check if there is a Macintosh OS X 10.6.x driver available from the
Downloads
tab for your product. If it's available, download the driver and follow the on-screen installation instructions to install driver.

faqs.question: Epson Print CD quits unexpectedly when printing from my Mac. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Do the following:
Validate the system's fonts:
Close Epson Print CD and open the
Applications
folder.
Open
Font Book
.
Highlight all of the fonts in the list, then click
File
and
Validate Fonts
.
Remove any corrupted fonts that the software finds and is unable to correct.
Restart your Macintosh, then start Epson Print CD.
If validating the system's fonts does not work, try creating a new user account:
Click the Apple icon, then select
System Preferences
.
Under
System
, select
Accounts
.
If the padlock in the lower left corner is locked, click it to unlock it and enter the password when prompted.
Click the
+
to create a new account.
At the top, change the New Account field to
Administrator
.
Complete the required fields, then click
Create Account
.  (Do not set to automatically log in).
Close the Accounts screen, click on the Apple icon to log out, then log in as the new user.
Open Epson Print CD.
If you are able to use Epson Print CD with the new account but not with the old account, please contact Apple for possible solutions.
